_note: All data-prep thresholds in one place. 'drop' removes a clip from training; 'flag' keeps it but lists it in keep_drop.csv for a listen.
_cer_note: CER per language group, recomputed in finalize.py from Whisper's raw text. Session 1 showed that Whisper forced to English TRANSLATES Hinglish into English, so Hinglish CER measures nothing: it is reported but never used to flag or drop (null). Hindi limits were loosened after session 1, where most Hindi 'errors' were Whisper spelling variants (रुपे/रुपये, अठारा/अठारह).
